_rules_comment: rules[] — короткий Style A чеклист для style_rules(). Детали категории — в category_rule.
rules: Playrix-like casual mobile game icon, glossy stylized 3D render
single hero object centered, readable silhouette
smooth rounded chunky shapes, soft beveled edges
glossy plastic/clay materials, soft studio light
no text, logos, watermarks, UI; no photo / cinematic still / anime / flat vector
negative: photorealistic snapshot, live-action photo, DSLR photo look, live-action cinematic still, film grain noise, grit, text, logo, watermark, UI overlay, picture frame border, flat vector, anime, collage, blurry, low contrast, disembodied hands, wrong object, abstract blob

categories._comment: Категории 1–5 по ТЗ. Фоны Style A: gradient / pattern / soft sunburst.

1.object: simple object without tiny detail scatter, hanging in the air, no visible surface under it; silhouette readable (optics/lenses only if essential to read the object)
1.background: monochrome Style A backdrop with soft gradient, OR simple pattern (stripes, repeating motif, flat color, or soft light rays / sunburst)
1.forbid: no floor, table, museum pedestal, room, landscape, second hero object

2.object: simple object without tiny detail scatter, standing on a simple surface with soft contact shadow; silhouette readable (optics/lenses only if essential)
2.background: object on a surface; behind — a vertical plane that is monochrome with soft gradient OR a simple pattern (stripes, repeating motif, flat color, or soft light rays / sunburst)
2.forbid: no full outdoor/indoor location, no landscape scene, second hero object

3.object: object standing on a realistic surface and integrated into that simple realistic ground, large and central; silhouette readable
3.background: realistic surface in front (volumetric ground); behind — a vertical plane that is monochrome with soft gradient OR a simple pattern (stripes / light rays) — not a full outdoor world
3.forbid: no full outdoor/indoor location, no competing still-life clutter, no second hero

4.object: object integrated into a realistic surrounding environment but remains the clear central focus
4.background: full realistic Style A environment with depth (grass field, sea/coast, beach, museum interior, sky — as in TZ examples); never busier than the hero
4.forbid: no empty studio void, no people (unless cat.5), no second competing hero

5.object: one or two stylized characters acting out a very simple narrative beat, characters stay central
5.background: realistic environment like category 4 framing the scene
5.forbid: no more than two characters, no crowded cast

collection._comment: Collection layout rules from the brief. Validated in app/pipeline/stages.py — keep in sync with _validate_plan.
collection.structure: A collection covers one broad theme and contains 16 sets of 10 cards each. A set is a sub-theme of the collection.
rules: A set is a sub-theme of the collection: for “Summer” that is “Beach”, “Garden”, “Sports”.
Sets inside one collection must not repeat or overlap in meaning.
Objects must read by silhouette at icon size: avoid noisy micro-detail scatter (lenses and clear object parts are fine).
Objects must not repeat inside one set.

Every set includes all four composition categories (independent of rarity/stars): 1 — simple object floating in air; 2 — simple object on a simple surface + vertical backdrop; 3 — object on a realistic surface + simple volumetric/vertical backdrop; 4 — object integrated into a realistic environment, still central. Category 5 (gold) is a narrative beat with 1–2 characters only when gold is enabled.
Rarity does not change how the object looks: the same item at ★1 and ★5 is drawn the same.
No text, lettering, logos, or recognizable trademarks inside the art.
No real people or recognizable characters — generalized objects only (characters only on gold category-5 cards when enabled).

gold_cards._why: Current cinema sets are WITHOUT gold cards. Keep code support: set true to add category-5 cards.
rules: Gold card = category 5: a tiny story beat with a category-4 style environment.
One gold card has one or two characters, no more.
Characters play a simple ironic emotional beat; characters stay centered.
Set 16 is a grand set: gold cards only, climax theme for the whole collection.

variant_strategy: Set variants must differ by creative angle, not by palette.
Bad: five sets of the same objects in different colors.
Good: different approaches to the sub-theme — another slice, era, or side of the subject.
Object overlap between variants — at most two.
